name: @csszyx/ts-plugin
description: Bounded sz/szv/szs completions for compatible TypeScript language-service hosts

scripts.test: pnpm run build && node tests/spike.test.mjs && node tests/contract.test.mjs && node tests/proxy.test.mjs && node tests/performance.test.mjs && node tests/pack.test.mjs && node tests/tsserver.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run build && c8 --reporter=lcovonly --reporter=text-summary --report-dir=coverage --src=src --include='dist/**/*.js' --exclude='dist/plugin.js' node tests/coverage-runner.mjs && node scripts/repo-relative-lcov.mjs
